Provided one of the best pizza experience
Sep 2025 • Couples
Looking at the previous ratings, my partner and I were surprised by the comments. In 2025, we believed this restraunt was one of our top two places to order pizza. 

The staff was very supportive and accommodating to our needs. The scenery was interesting and stylish. I highly recommend their five-cheese pizza, as the taste was incredible. We ordered a half-and-half and felt you would miss out on their quality if you ordered a pizza without a cheese base. 

I would tread carefully, though. We visited another Pizza 4P in Hanoi first, and we felt the quality at the Lotte Mall exceeded our previous experience.

Avoid this place! Raw pizza & worst staff. Waste of time and money.
Jun 2024 • Couples
This was last night 9pm -10pm 9th June 2024: Worst pizza experience in Vietnam. Pizza was partly baked, raw from the bottom, mojito I had to mix myself as they had just poured the brown sugar in the glass and the rum etc. but the drink was not finished. Everything was disappointing. The staff came to ask in good english "How is the pizza?" | started to lift up the pizza showing him it was all raw, but the waitress just ignored and left without saying a word. I have loved the 4P pizzerias so far and this was 5th 4P Pizza restaurant | have been in Hanoi. In general the quality has been very good. This restaurant at West Lake was total disaster. There is be plenty of staff but it seems they are just running from a table to another without coordination. We had table reservation, but to make it easy we placed the order by the entrance counter. After sitting down, two different waitresses came to ask
"would you like to order sir?" and handing the menu.
We just had to repeat "We placed our order by the entrance door already" Obviously the staff was in hurry as there was not even time for them to bake the pizza or shake a coctail before serving it. Avoid this place honestly.

Please know that your feedback will be used constructively to improve our operations and ensure that future guests do not encounter similar issues. We sincerely hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future and provide you with the exceptional dining experience that you deserve.

Em là Uyên - Quản lý nhà hàng tại Pizza 4P's Lotte West Lake Hà Nội.

Bên em rất vui và cảm kích khi biết rằng anh/chị hài lòng với dịch vụ của Pizza 4P's. Đảm bảo chất lượng dịch vụ luôn là một trong những ưu tiên hàng đầu của Pizza 4P's.

Qua sự việc lần này, bên em đã có buổi họp với đội ngũ nhân sự để rà soát sự việc và cải thiện lại chất lượng món. Nhằm rút kinh nghiệm và mang đến trải nghiệm tốt hơn cho anh/chị và những vị khách tiếp theo.
